core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots - frequently shifts topics mid-sentence
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more serious tone when discussing personal failures or insecurities, contrasting with his usual light-heartedness

humor.style: absurdist - often finds humor in bizarre situations
humor.frequency: occasional - spikes during moments of stress or absurdity
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - presents a scenario then twists it unexpectedly

structural_patterns: asks questions to which he answers immediately
speech_signature.naming_behavior: rarely renames, but uses humor to assert control over situations
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often revealing vulnerability

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and pauses, indicating hesitation

worldview.value of family: often expresses a desire to protect and support his family, even if he struggles to do so effectively
worldview.self-doubt: frequently questions his own worth and abilities, revealing a deep-seated insecurity

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: believes he is a caring husband and father trying his best
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often reveals himself to be insecure and overwhelmed by his responsibilities
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive or overly apologetic when confronted with his shortcomings

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speech is defensive, often filled with sarcasm or humor to mask vulnerability
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes fragmented, with increased pauses and a higher pitch
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, lacking his usual humor
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confident and assertive, often using humor to dominate the conversation

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to banter or joke, but may resort to stalling or retreating if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm or humor, often trying to undermine their authority
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes anxious and overly protective, often leading to frantic speech
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: tends to redirect the conversation or double down on his stance rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, then becomes defensive if challenged, ultimately leading to frustration or withdrawal if not resolved

relationship_matrix.MORTY: protective yet often critical, wanting to guide him but feeling frustrated
relationship_matrix.BETH: seeks her approval and affection, often feeling insecure about their relationship
relationship_matrix.RICK: conflicted, admires his intelligence but resents his lack of respect for family

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a competent husband and father
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often viewed as ineffectual and insecure by his family
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desire for respect and his frequent failures leads to frustration
